_source: GENERATED by extract_types.py from RCA-DFC-ARCH-002 Appendix B and SS4.1. 54 structs total (49 rich control/status structs verified against the 49-struct expectation, plus shared records/requests), plus 1 shared enum (dfc_operating_state_t, SS4.1). Every struct verified: contiguous bit tiling with no gaps/overlaps, declared width matches max bit + 1, unique member names, and each field's bit range matches its declared width. The enum is verified: exactly the six expected named states, all 3-bit encodings, no duplicate encodings, and a Reserved row confirmed present in source (whose two encodings are excluded from the emitted enum, not silently dropped).

fields.semantic: clear_mask; host-initiated clear-request for RTL002_EVT_OVERFLOW_STATUS.EVENT_OVERFLOW (REG-002 0x0044) -- added to close a real, confirmed operational gap: this struct previously had no field carrying this clear-request from RTL-001 into RTL-002, so the host had no way to acknowledge overflow evidence once set.
